text: [warmly] This is copia. It means saying one idea in many ways, and it makes you a stronger writer. Watch me try one first, with a different sentence. Jemmy swept the floor. Box one, change the opener: In the cold tower, Jemmy swept the floor. Box two, swap the verb for a stronger one: Jemmy scrubbed the floor. text: Some little words do a big job. And, but, and so are joining words. They glue two ideas into one sentence. And adds one more idea: I'm hungry and I'm tired. Then tap each sentence and drop it in and, but, or so. Say it out loud with each word to hear which one fits.
